_note: Golden set for the deterministic tagger. Each case: chunk text and the expected primary topic id (null = must stay untagged). Threshold for the suite: precision >= 0.8.

topics.name: Shared Resources
topics.description: Mutual exclusion for shared resources; critical sections must be protected.

topics.name: Priority Inversion
topics.description: A low priority task blocks a high priority task by holding a resource.

topics.name: Deadlocks
topics.description: Circular wait: mutual exclusion, hold and wait, no preemption.

cases.content: When a low priority task holds a lock the high task needs, priority inheritance fixes the wait.
Circular waiting needs mutual exclusion plus hold-and-wait plus no preemption together.
Enter a critical section only after acquiring the lock protecting the shared resource.
Deadlock can also arise when two tasks hold resources in opposite order.
